title: obs-browser: Update to 2.27.0
body:
### Description

obs-browser: Update to 2.27.0

- https://github.com/obsproject/obs-browser/commit/5d2aadb Update to C++20
- https://github.com/obsproject/obs-browser/commit/d7065f9 cmake: Update Info.plist generation for macOS
- https://github.com/obsproject/obs-browser/commit/bb9b32e Enable support for CEF 6613+ and Chrome Runtime
- https://github.com/obsproject/obs-browser/commit/77bad77 Use constexpr for disabled command line features
- https://github.com/obsproject/obs-browser/commit/1d24808 Disable global shortcuts portal integration
- https://github.com/obsproject/obs-browser/commit/f555da0 Update version to 2.27.0

### Motivation and Context

Prepare for CEF upgrade.

See:

* https://github.com/obsproject/obs-browser/pull/523

### How Has This Been Tested?

Launch OBS with existing CEF on Windows.

### Types of changes

 - Tweak (non-breaking change to improve existing functionality)

- [x] I have read the [**contributing** document](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md).

- [x] My code follows the project's [**style guidelines**](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/blob/master/CODESTYLE.md)

- [x] All commit messages are properly formatted and commits squashed where appropriate.
